90
RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the December 22, 2004/Pausa 1, 1926 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Defence; Home Affairs; Non-Conventional Energy Sources; Power;
Rural Development; Textiles; Youth Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions — 20
Repeal of Armed Forces Special
Powers Act
*301. SHRI MANOJ BHATTA-
CHARYA: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are
considering a proposal to repeal the Armed
Forces Special Powers Act from entire
Manipur as a major step to restore
normalcy and peace in the N.E. Region;
(b) whether the view- point of the State
Government of Manipur has been
ascertained in this regard; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and the
response of the State Government thereto?
Protection of the domestic silk
industry
*302. SHRIMATI S.G. INDIRA:
SHRIMATI BIMBA RAIKAR:
 Will the Minister of TEXTILES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Government are aware
that the Chinese are using new methods to
dump their silk into this country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also true that due to
dumping of silk by the Chinese, the
domestic silk industry has been affected
drastically; and
(d) if so, the steps taken by Government
to protect domestic silk industry?
Internal security
*303. SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) what measures on the ground have
Government taken to track the reported co-
operation among domestic extremist
groups in various States and the external
groups in Pakistan, Bangladesh and Nepal;
(b) whether Government have clear-cut
policy to deal with such matters

91
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
endangering country's internal security;
and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Categorisation of Orissa as B-1 State
*304. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Chief
Minister of Orissa has made a request to
categorize Orissa as a B-1 State in line with
three of its neighbours to enable it to get
Central assistance at a higher ratio;
(b) whether he has also asked for
creation of a Corpus Fund for meeting
expenses relating to security related
matters; and
(c) if so, the status of these proposals
and the time-frame within which these
proposals would be cleared?
Assistance by International agencies
*305. PROF. ALKA BALRAM
KSHATRIYA:
SHRI RAJU PARMAR:
Will the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether international agencies like
World Bank and Asian Development Bank
are assisting the State Governments for
drinking water and sanitation schemes;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether Central Government is also
providing financial assistance for drinking
water and sanitation in various States
including Gujarat under some guidelines;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Opening of sports academy
†*306. SHRIMATI KUM KUM RAI:
Will the Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS
AND SPORTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that in view of
Paucity of resources in the States, the
Ministry of Sports had formulated a scheme
to open a sports academy;
(b) the State-wise position of the said
sports academy; and
(c) the number of States wherein the
players are planned to be trained with
scientific methods?
Abductions by ULFA
*307. SHRI AMAR SINGH: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) what is the number of persons
reported to have been abducted by the
members of United Liberation Front of
Assam during the last two years;
(b) how many of them have been freed/
killed during that period; and
(c) whether it is a fact that a few NRIs
are still in the custody of the United
Liberation Front and if so, the details
thereof and steps taken for their release?
Dope testing system in India
*308. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
Will the Minister of YOUTH AFFAIRS
AND SPORTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India's system
for dope-testing is faulty and is open to
manipulation; and
(b) the details of dope-testing of Ms.
Sanamacha Chanu and Ms. Pratima
Kumari before they went to Athens?

92
Private participation in rural
development
*309. SHRI C.  RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will  the Minister of RURAL
DEVELOPMENT  be pleased to state:
(a) whether steps have been initiated by
Government for  rural development
through private sector;
(b) if so, which are the areas identified;
and
(c) what are the details of facilities,
concessions given to the private sector in
this regard?
Girls brought to Delhi and other metro
cities
†*310. SHRI AJAY MAROO: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government's attention has
been drawn towards the incidents of young
girls from Jharkhand being brought to
Delhi and other metro cities by luring them;
(b) whether any data are available in
this regard; and
(c) the steps being taken by Government
to check such type of incident

453
RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for WRITTEN  ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, the December 22, 2004/Pausa 1, 1926 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Defence; Home Affairs; Non-Conventional Energy Sources; Power;
Rural Development; Textiles; Youth Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions — 155
Defence imports
2055. SHRI SANJAY NIRUPAM: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that three
fourths of India's needs for military
equipment modernisation is met through
imports;
(b) whether India is still not able to
make its own production, designing and
development of equipment;
(c) whether Government is not
providing the necessary funds for the
above; and
(d) if so, the details about the import
and the funds being given thereto?
Status of APDRP in Karnataka
2056. SHRI K.B. KRISHNA
MURTHY: Will the Minister of POWER
be pleased to state the present status of
the accelerated Power Development
and Reforms Programme for rural
Karnataka ?
Objectives of NCC and TA
2057. SHRI S.S. AHLUWALIA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether National Cadet Corps
(NCC) and Territorial Army (TA) were
raised as auxiliary manpower among
students and youth trained to face
emergency situations;
(b) the details of the objectives that led
to raising of NCC and TA;
(c) the year-wise details of number of
students received NCC training and people
joined TA along with funds allocated to the
respective wings;
(d) whether keeping in view the
growing threats from weapons of mass
destruction to the civilian society, in

454
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
particular, any special training is being
imparted to NCC cadets and TA members
for disaster management in such
eventuality; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Defence agreements with Russia
2058. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) the details of Defence Agreements/
mutual commitments negotiated with
Russia during the recent visit of Russian
President;
(b) whether Russia has promised to
provide fighter/bomber aircrafts to India;
and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
U.S. defence aid to Pakistan
2059. SHRI V. NARAYANASAMY:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the U.S.
Government proposed to give 300 million
Dollar defence aid to Pakistan; and
(b) whether the Government of India is
fully prepared to meet the challenges posed
by Pak in view of the U.S. aid to Pakistan?
Sale of C-130J Super Hercules
Military Transport Aircraft to India
2060. SHRI EKANATH K. THAKUR:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the US is
aggressively hawking the C-130J Super
Hercules military transport aircraft to India;
(b) whether it is a fact that the American
delegations have held several meetings
with the Indian Air Force officials in the
recent past to push for the multi-million
dollar contract for the C-130 J; and
(c) if so, Government's response thereto
and the action proposed thereon?
Withdrawal of troops from Siachen
†2061. SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the move to withdraw the
troops deployed in Jammu and Kashmir to
certain extent will be enforced in Siachen
glacier also, if so, the extent of troops to
be withdrawn from Siachen;
(b) whether Pakistan Government has
sent a proposal for withdrawal of troops
from Siachen to the Government of India,
if so, the reaction of Government of India
thereto; and
(c) whether Government of India are of
the view that India's security interests
would be affected by withdrawal of troops
from Siachen, if so, to what extent?
Effect of withdrawal of Indian troops
on Pakistan army
†2062. SHRI PYARELAL
KHANDELWAL: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether in response to Indian action
of withdrawal of army from Jammu and
Kashmir has any effect on Pakistani army;
(b) whether Indian army has received
any proposal from Government of Pakistan
to visit Pakistan;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether any proposal is under
consideration of Government of India to
invite a group of Pakistani soldiers to visit
India; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?

455
Repair/replacement of defective
missiles by Air Headquarters
2063. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is fact that Air
Headquarters had failed to get defective
missiles repaired/replaced at the cost of the
foreign vendor within the warranty period;
and
(b) if so, the reasons therefor?
Proposed sale of Orion PC-3
Surveillance Aircraft to
Pakistan by USA
2064. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government is aware that
USA has proposed sale of Orion PC-3
Surveillance Aircraft and Tow Missiles to
Pakistan;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether our Defence Forces are fully
prepared to take on the enhanced capability
of Pakistan;
